text_block_list.text:
Today is a holiday, and I'm really
fortunate to
have it off. I'm intent on
taking it easy, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Won't you grab the chicken
for me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And that bottle of soda while you're at
it! Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Sky! Only I get to order my trainer around
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's fine! Just for a little bit.
You don't
mind, do you, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
King! The pizza place just called! They'll
be here
soon!
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
And, um... they mentioned that it's for
"fifty
people" or something...
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Fifty?! Not five?! Who ordered all that pizza?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I did! Think about it, this way we can
each have at
least five pizzas!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: What? Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My office has been completely
transformed into
Кинг Хало and her
friends' party venue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Too lively... I know I'm the one who
invited
everyone, but...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Viva la pizza!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Howdy. Your pizza's all ready. I've also
got your
thirty orders of fries right here
too.
text_block_list.name: Pizza Delivery

text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you so much! ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys! Aren't you going a bit
overboard?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: All right, everything's all cleaned up!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That was pretty fun. I'm looking forward
to next
year.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Next year? You want me to host another
party
like this?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! No, no, no.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: I'm talking about our races next year!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Geez... What is it with her?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
It seems like you're getting along with
everyone.

text_block_list.text: Hmph! Says you!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Every year, they always include me in
their
holiday plans without consulting
me ahead of
time! It's not normal!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Every year, they always include me in
their
holiday plans without consulting
me ahead of
time! It's not normal!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Well, starting next year you'll be participating too, so we'll be able to put together something even more extravagant.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Maybe you can rent out a hotel floor for
us next
year? I want a lavish party fit for
a king!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: "Participating?" You're just trying to use me!

text_block_list.text:
Hm? I don't see any problem with
putting you to
work a little.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You are my trainer, after all.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Seeing how things have gone this year, it
seems
fitting that you stay along for the
ride.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Here's to another fun year, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Well, starting next year you'll be participating too, so we'll be able to put together something even more extravagant.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's right. And the year after that. And
every
year after that.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm allowing you the honor of continuing
to be of
use to me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That includes holiday parties like today,
New
Year's events, and the races I'll be
running over
the next few years.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Why shouldn't I give you the right to continue accompanying me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Is it not the greatest gift you could have
asked
for? Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yes, you heard me. It's from yours truly.
Now
show some appreciation!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer, it's snowing! Hey, have
you ever
built a snowman?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Guess I can look forward to another year
of being
bossed around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, Кинг Хало promises to keep
putting me
to work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
